name: say
description: Speak a line out loud to the person (1-3 short sentences), with the emotion and speech act that fit it.

emotion.description: neutral, warm, happy, amused, excited, sad, concerned, frustrated, surprised

act.description: statement, yes_no_question, wh_question, exclamation, instruction, reassurance, aside

name: get_time
description: The person's current local date and time (their own time zone).

name: get_location
description: Where the person is (their browser location if shared, otherwise roughly from their connection).

name: get_weather
description: Current weather and today's outlook where the person is, or in a named city.

name: get_forecast
description: Weather forecast for the next days where the person is, or in a named city.

name: get_news
description: Current news headlines: local to where the person is, on a topic, or top stories in their country.

local.description: true for news about where they are

name: pc_list
description: List files and folders in the folder they opened in VibeRoller (on THEIR computer).

path.description: Path inside that folder, "" for the folder itself

name: pc_read
description: Read a text file in the folder they opened (on their computer).

name: pc_write
description: Create or overwrite a text file in the folder they opened (on their computer).

name: pc_mkdir
description: Make a folder in the folder they opened (on their computer).

name: pc_delete
description: Delete a file or folder in the folder they opened (on their computer).

name: run_code
description: Run a short JavaScript or Python program in their browser (sandboxed, on their computer, no files or network) and get its printed output.

code.description: The program; print / console.log what you want back

name: web_search
description: Search the web; returns titles, links and snippets.

name: read_page
description: Read a public web page as text (to answer from it or summarise it).

name: play_youtube
description: Find a YouTube video (music, clips, anything) and play it for them right in the chat.

query.description: What to play, or a YouTube link

name: generate_image
description: Make a picture with the image engine (photos, art, scenes, objects; selfie true for a picture of yourself). The picture is shown with your reply.

prompt.description: The picture, written fresh from THIS moment, most important first: what is happening right now in the conversation, what you are doing, where you are, who is with you, what you are wearing for it, expression, the time of day and the weather where they are, mood, lighting, camera angle. For a selfie never describe your face or hair (that is added for you): describe the moment.

selfie.description: true when the picture shows you

name: edit_image
description: Change a whole picture: restyle it, turn it into something else, put the person somewhere new. Works from the last picture, the photo they sent (camera) or a given one.

image.description: "last" (default: the last picture in this chat), "camera" (the last photo they sent) or a picture id like t-user/abc

prompt.description: What the new picture should be, written fully (the whole scene, not just the change)

strength.description: How much to change, 0.2 (a little) to 0.95 (almost new); default 0.55

keep_face.description: true to keep the person in the photo looking like themselves

name: inpaint_image
description: Repaint only one area of a picture (box = left, top, right, bottom as fractions 0-1); the rest stays.

box.description: Four numbers 0-1: left, top, right, bottom

keep_face.description: true to keep the person looking like themselves

name: calculate
description: Evaluate a math expression (numbers, + - * / % ^ parentheses, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, ln, abs, round, pi, e).

name: add_task
description: Create a task / to-do item.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks (filter: pending, done, overdue or all).

name: complete_task
description: Mark a task done.

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task permanently.

name: set_task_priority
description: Set a task priority (1 highest, 10 lowest).

name: set_task_due
description: Set a task due date/time.

name: add_task_note
description: Add a note to a task.

name: search_tasks
description: Search tasks by text.

name: add_event
description: Add a calendar event.

name: today_events
description: Today's calendar events (the person's local day).

name: upcoming_events
description: Calendar events for the next N days.

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event by id.

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder; it pops up in VibeRoller (and is spoken) when due.

name: list_reminders
description: List reminders that have not gone off yet.

name: delete_reminder
description: Delete a reminder by id.

name: remember
description: Store a key/value in working memory (names, preferences, short facts about the person).

name: recall_memory
description: Recall working memory (all entries when key is omitted).

name: forget_memory
description: Remove a working-memory key.

name: learn
description: Store a fact in the long-term knowledge base.

name: recall_knowledge
description: Search the long-term knowledge base.

name: forget_knowledge
description: Delete a knowledge entry by id.

name: list_capabilities
description: What you can do for the person in VibeRoller.
